fields.label: Decision+
fields.desc: swing or take, graded against the league optimum for that pitch and count

fields.label: Timing+
fields.desc: timing: how far out front on soft stuff relative to fastballs

fields.label: Power+
fields.desc: location adjusted bat speed combined with location adjusted lift

fields.label: paBS+
fields.desc: location adjusted bat speed, the engine half of Power+

fields.label: paAA+
fields.desc: location adjusted attack angle, the lift half of Power+

fields.label: Hitting+
fields.desc: refit combination of all components, calibrated to wOBA

fields.label: Contact+
fields.desc: whiff avoidance: did the bat find the ball

fields.label: xwOBA
fields.desc: expected production from the batted balls, the calibration target

fields.label: Extra bases
fields.desc: total bases above what that batted ball usually yields

fields.label: Confidence
fields.desc: sample relative to the stabilization point, 0 to 1

fields.label: Expected Whiff%
fields.desc: expected whiff rate on the pitches he swung at, given their location, count and pitch family
